profile.headline: Senior Associate Software Developer at SAS

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.locationName: Cary, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Year-Round Technical Intern
positions.description:
• Implementing changes to a mid-tier API service using Go and Kubernetes with tools including Jira and Gerrit
• Contributing as a part of the Analytics Ops department of the Research and Development Advanced Analytics division to a Jenkins-based DevOps platform that allows product engineers to rapidly create Kubernetes clusters

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed as a part of the Analytics Ops department of the Research and Development Advanced Analytics division to a Jenkins-based DevOps platform that allows product engineers to rapidly create Kubernetes clusters
• Converted a Jenkins Freestyle Project for creating a Kubernetes cluster on OpenStack to a Jenkins Declarative Pipeline using Groovy
• Added Azure support for Kubernetes cluster creation and build parameter validation to the Jenkins pipeline
• Mentored another intern with getting started using React and organized a weekly coffee chat of 4 other interns

positions.title: GUI Lead
positions.description:
• Part of “The Diggeridoos” team in the Not-a-Boring Competition hosted by Elon Musk’s The Boring Company
• Won international “Fastest Launch Design” award with only 4 of the 12 finalist teams receiving awards
• Promoted to GUI Lead for excellent front end contributions
• Built tunnel boring machine monitoring application with Electron, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and CSS/Sass
• Performed code reviews for other team members’ Git pull-requests and onboarded new code contributors for the Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) and Graphical User Interface (GUI) sub-team

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed with others a software-as-a-service (SaaS) prospect assessment tool to survey potential customers and identify consulting opportunities
•	Completed skills training in writing Java unit tests (JUnit and Mockito) and integration tests (Cucumber)
•	Built front end views in HTML/CSS/Sass and JavaScript (ES8) using TypeScript, React, Bootstrap, Redux, and React Router
•	Implemented REST API changes using Java, Spring, PostgreSQL, and JHipster

positions.title: Web Design Freelancer
positions.description:
•	Migrated a non-profit website from Joomla to WordPress and rewrote portions of a WordPress plugin using PHP to fit customer requirements
•	Set up an e-commerce system and designed the product customization process for a Kydex accessory business
•	Designed a consignment shop website with a searchable product catalog
•	Built additional sites in HTML/CSS/Sass, WordPress, Adobe Photoshop, and Illustrator

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with other interns and employees to build a software-as-a-service (SaaS) data analytics and visualization tool for tracking popularity and sentiment of Twitter discussion topics
•	Implemented the front end in HTML/CSS/Sass and JavaScript (ES8) using TypeScript, React, Bootstrap, D3.js, Redux, React Router, and JHipster
•	Designed the REST API specification using Swagger/OpenAPI
•	Prototyped the user interface (UI) with Figma
•	Helped with building the Java REST API powered by JHipster, Spring, and Apache Kafka and deploying to Amazon Web Services (AWS) using a continuous integration (CI) / continuous delivery (CD) pipeline

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jan 2014
